final: SELECT CASE a.frequency WHEN 'POPLATEK MESICNE' THEN 'Monthly' WHEN 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN 'Weekly' WHEN 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' THEN 'After each transaction' END AS statement_frequency, CASE o.k_symbol WHEN 'POJISTNE' THEN 'Insurance payment' WHEN 'SIPO' THEN 'Household payment' WHEN 'LEASING' THEN 'Leasing payment' WHEN 'UVER' THEN 'Loan payment' END AS purpose_of_3539_debit FROM account AS a JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND o.amount = 3539
